headline: Sensex jumps 600 points and Nifty tops 25,900 led by IT buying and Glenmark Pharma's record high

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows boosted investor sentiment in early trade
Buying interest in IT shares supported the market rally
Glenmark Pharma reached a new 52-week high
Sensex rose 600 points while Nifty crossed the 25,900 mark
whatHappening: The Indian Rupee weakened by 20 paise to 92.40 against the US dollar
Brent crude prices rose above $95 per barrel, impacting Indian bonds
RBI flagged concerns regarding food inflation risks
Tata Trusts is set to challenge N Chandrasekaran's reappointment in court
summary: Indian markets rallied with the Sensex gaining 600 points, driven by foreign inflows and IT sector strength. Glenmark Pharma hit a 52-week high, while macro pressures like rising Brent crude and a weaker Rupee weighed. Legal challenges to Tata leadership and RBI inflation warnings are also in focus.
